title: Pain feeling extra loud?
caption: Pain feeling extra loud? Space is stormy today, and that can make joints and muscles grumble and stack tension faster, then ease when you move gently. Keep plans soft: try easy stretches and short walks, and swap heavy lifts for lighter, slower reps.
snapshot: Geomagnetic storming continues with elevated solar wind. The magnetic field orientation supports ongoing activity. There are no notable solar flares or eruptions in the recent window. A minor aurora chance exists in some areas over the next few nights.
affects: Pain sensitivity may climb, showing up as louder joint or muscle complaints and lower tolerance for long holds or repetitive tasks. Tension can stack faster in the neck and shoulders, and then ease when you move gently. Evenings can settle if you cut bright light and stimulation.
playbook:
- Choose gentle range-of-motion and short walks
- Swap heavy lifts for lighter, slower reps
- Use heat or a warm shower on tight spots
- Break up repetitive chores with brief pauses
- Lower screen brightness and keep the evening quiet
